Stock market news | RBI new ATM and card rules limit free withdrawals

On 27 November 2026, the Reserve Bank of India released new regulations for ATM usage and card transactions. The rules change the number of free withdrawals, allow banks to impose additional fees and tighten contactless payment limits, affecting everyday banking for consumers.
